name: create_booking
description: Use only after check_availability has confirmed the exact slot and the caller has agreed to it. Collect synthetic demo name and phone details, then create the appointment. Never send real personal details.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch the caller selected.

serviceId.description: The ID of the service the caller selected.

date.description: The confirmed local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

stylistId.description: The preferred stylist's ID. Omit when the caller requested any stylist so the confirmed available stylist is assigned.

time.description: The confirmed available local start time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

customerName.description: The synthetic demo name the caller provides after being warned not to share real details.

customerPhone.description: The synthetic demo phone number the caller provides after being warned not to share real details.
